description: Active ontology version for the light-aircraft knowledge graph. Versioned independently of both the graph data and the access policy: the schema's meaning can evolve (terms added, renamed, deprecated) without re-importing data or changing who may see what. Every answer records the ontology version it was grounded in.

deprecated.note: Renamed for clarity (service ceiling, not absolute ceiling). Retained in the ontology so older queries and documents remain interpretable; current data uses serviceCeiling_ft.
